item.title: Overwatch Adds a 6v6 Role Queue Competitive Mode for the First Four Weeks of Season 6 (2026)
item.description:
Blizzard is adding a 6v6 Role Queue mode to Overwatch Competitive play. The mode launches on the first day of Season 6 as a four week Competitive mini season with a 2-2-2 role setup: two tanks, two damage heroes, and two supports per team. Game director Aaron Keller announced the change in a Director's Take blog post.

The mini season comes with a balance patch made specifically for 6v6, which Keller calls the community's biggest request for the mode after Role Queue itself.

Three Competitive Modes in Overwatch Season 6

Overwatch launched with six player teams and later moved to five, mainly to improve queue times and fix gameplay problems. Open Queue switched back to 6v6 nearly two years ago and became the second most played mode in Season 5. On day one of Season 6, Competitive offers:

  • standard 5v5 Role Queue, which stays the main mode
  • Open Queue 6v6, which also gets the new 6v6 balance patch
  • the new 6v6 Role Queue test, running for the first four weeks of the season

Blizzard says it keeps Open Queue 6v6 running alongside the test to learn whether players choose it for the role flexibility or for the team size. Two earlier 6v6 tests this year used different queue methods and did not deliver what players wanted, according to Keller.

Queue Times and the Future of 6v6

Role Queue 6v6 needs two tanks per team, which has historically made queues longer. Blizzard says Season 6 ships with matchmaking changes that it expects to keep queue times manageable, and that the team will monitor queue times across all modes.

Blizzard's surveys showed players split almost evenly between the two formats, and 32 percent of respondents on each side backed their preferred mode fully. The 6v6 balance patch addresses heroes whose strength differs between the formats. Keller names D.Mon as more effective in 6v6 and Domina as less effective.

Keller says Blizzard has no plans to move the main mode of Overwatch to 6v6. "We're starting to think of it as a second among equals," he writes, adding that the team will put more work into balance patches for the mode. Limited time modes continue alongside both formats, and Mystery Madness returns in Season 1 2027 with a new theme and new powers.

Players who want to try the mode should queue for it during the first four weeks of Season 6, since the test ends after that. Results from the mini season will decide whether Role Queue 6v6 returns. Season 6 also brings a new hero, whose full reveal is planned for the OWCS Finals broadcast.

Blizzard has not announced the start date of Season 6 in the post or said whether 6v6 Role Queue will return after the mini season ends.

Players who want to try the mode should queue for it during the first four weeks of Season 6, since the test ends after that. Results from the mini season will decide whether Role Queue 6v6 returns. Season 6 also brings a new hero, whose full reveal is planned for the OWCS Finals broadcast.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Enters Its Second Day as Outlook, Teams, and Copilot Stay Down Worldwide (2026)
item.description:
A worldwide Microsoft 365 outage that started on November 12 at around 18:00 UTC is still not fixed. Users have been unable to read or send email in Outlook, join Teams meetings, use Copilot, or reach cloud PCs, and Microsoft's own fixes have not restored service so far. At 12:00 UTC on November 13, Microsoft said users were still "unable to connect to multiple Microsoft 365 services."

Microsoft says the outage affects Microsoft 365 services "that interact with Exchange Online and email services." Services that do not depend on Exchange Online keep working.

Which Microsoft 365 Services Are Affected

Microsoft's list of affected services is long, which is why the outage hits organizations so hard. It includes:

  • Outlook email and calendars, and some parts of Teams
  • Copilot, the Microsoft 365 admin center, and Microsoft 365 apps
  • Intune, Planner, To Do, SharePoint Online, and Power Apps
  • Defender for Office 365, Defender XDR, Purview, and Graph
  • Windows 365, Universal Print, Fabric, and Education features

Parts of the UK government have had trouble sending and receiving email, and the NHS has reportedly been unable to offer online consultations to patients. Government offices in the US and other countries have reportedly been affected too. Xbox players also report sign in problems, digital games that do not launch, and failing cloud saves, even though the Xbox status page shows all services as working.

What Microsoft Says About the Cause

Microsoft first blamed a problem "that's causing servers to fail automated health checks and become unavailable." A fix followed, but the company later admitted that "actions taken thus far have not provided the anticipated relief." Attempts to add capacity by scaling up virtual machines ran into machines stuck in a bad state, which stopped the changes from syncing.

The company says it is still working to "pinpoint the underlying cause of the traffic influx." On the question of a cyberattack, Microsoft's latest statement reads: "At this time, we have no evidence of malicious activity associated with this incident." It promises a full Post Incident Report with the root cause after the problem is fixed.

To protect email during recovery, Microsoft has extended the email timeout window to 48 hours. Microsoft says this is meant to preserve delayed messages, and the company is processing mail queues and backlogs first.

Microsoft's most recent update reports "positive results for service stability and increased capacity" after its latest traffic changes, and the company is applying them across affected regions. Administrators can follow the incident under ID MO1550821 in the Microsoft 365 admin center, or on the Microsoft 365 status page if the admin center does not load.

Microsoft has not given an estimated time for full recovery.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen in Search and the Gemini App, Replacing Gemini 3.8 Flash (2026)
item.description:
Google has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast and efficient model in its Gemini 4 family. It replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash and is rolling out now in Google Search, the Gemini app, Google Sheets, and Google's developer tools. Google says Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash.

Hydrogen joins the heavier Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon models. Google says it is built for everyday work, coding, and agentic tasks that do not need deep reasoning.

Where Gemini 4 Hydrogen Is Available

Hydrogen now powers responses in Google Search for all users worldwide. In the Gemini app, it appears in the model menu, and free users are routed to it automatically when Gemini decides it suits the prompt. Availability by product:

  • Google Search: all users, globally
  • Gemini app: in the model menu, used automatically for free users
  • Google Sheets: Google AI Pro, Ultra, and eligible Workspace users
  • Google Antigravity: Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers
  • Developers: Google AI Studio, Android Studio, and the Gemini API

In Search, Google says Hydrogen handles multi part questions and typos better and gives more visual answers. Search results will also show a wider range of links to websites.

In the Gemini app, Google says Hydrogen follows formatting, tone, and other instructions more closely, and keeps following them through longer conversations. It also works better with connected apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, Dropbox, and Airtable, and picks the right tool more often for multi step tasks. In Sheets, Google says it turns financial data into interactive forecasting models more than 30 percent faster than before.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen Benchmarks and API Price

Hydrogen scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default thinking level, one point ahead of Gemini 4 Argon at 50, and 54 at its highest setting. It offers four thinking levels: low, medium, high, and a new xhigh level. Users pay in time and tokens only for the depth they choose.

For developers, the model has a 1 million token context window and costs:

  1. $1.50 per million input tokens
  2. $7.50 per million output tokens

A new Orchestrator feature in Google Antigravity switches between Gemini 4 Carbon for planning and Hydrogen for execution. Google says this cuts quota usage by 24 percent and speeds up tasks by nearly 20 percent.

Google also published safety figures. It says Hydrogen reduces agentic overreach by up to 81 percent compared with Gemini 3.8 Flash, cuts misaligned shortcuts by 12 times, is up to twice as unlikely to bypass permission restrictions, and reached a 96.7 percent honesty rate in internal agent tests.

Hydrogen is free to use in Search and the Gemini app. Google has not said when Gemini 3.8 Flash will be removed from the API.

item.title: Fairphone Gets Its First US Carrier as Boost Mobile Activates the $650 Fairphone Gen. 6+ (2026)
item.description:
Fairphone has announced its first US carrier partnership. Buyers of the $650 Fairphone Gen. 6+ can now choose Boost Mobile as their carrier when they order the phone. Fairphone has sold phones in Europe for more than a decade but only started selling them in the US this summer.

Fairphone's chief commercial officer, Rutger Sneep, calls the deal phase one of a long term collaboration and says more news on "joint go to market plans" is coming.

How the Boost Mobile Deal Works

Boost Mobile will not sell the phone in its online store or retail shops. Buyers still order the Gen. 6+ from Fairphone or Amazon and activate it on Boost with any of its plans. The steps when buying from Fairphone are:

  1. Order the Fairphone Gen. 6+ on Fairphone's website.
  2. Select a Boost Mobile plan during checkout.
  3. Wait for the eSIM activation email, which arrives when the phone is delivered.

There is no discount for choosing Boost. The phone keeps its $650 price, and it can still be bought unlocked. Boost is a mobile virtual network operator that leases network access instead of running its own; it mainly uses AT&T's network, with some access to T-Mobile. The Gen. 6+ is certified for both of those networks.

Fairphone Gen. 6+ Specs and Repair Costs

The Gen. 6+ is the only cellular device Fairphone sells in the US. Its main hardware:

  • Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 with 12 GB of RAM
  • 256 GB of storage plus a microSD slot for up to 2 TB
  • 6.31 inch AMOLED display at up to 120 Hz
  • 4,415 mAh battery with 30 W wired charging
  • 50 MP main and 13 MP ultrawide cameras
  • Android 16 out of the box, with software support through 2033

The phone ships with a screwdriver, and owners can replace 12 modules themselves, including the USB C port, the battery, the display, and the cameras. Fairphone sells a replacement battery for $40 and a display for $90. An iPhone 17 battery replacement costs $99 and a display repair $329.

The phone has a five year warranty, as long as owners register it within 90 days of purchase. Sneep says Boost customers will not need to visit a store for repairs, since parts can be ordered to their door and complex cases go to a repair center.

The partnership comes as the smartphone market shrinks. Industry data shows shipments fell 19 percent year over year in the third quarter of 2026, while revenue rose 3 percent because of higher prices. Fairphone says its own phone sales rose 74 percent in the first half of the year.

Fairphone has not said when Boost Mobile will sell the phone directly.

Thank you for being a Ghacks reader. The post Fairphone Gets Its First US Carrier as Boost Mobile Activates the $650 Fairphone Gen. 6+ appeared first on gHacks.

item.title: Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially in Production at MachineGames, and id Software Confirms a New Game (2026)
item.description:
Wolfenstein 3 is officially in development at MachineGames, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced on X as part of Xbox's 25th anniversary celebrations. "Wolfenstein 3 is officially in production at @MachineGames," Sharma wrote. "One of gaming's most important franchises, and a team that has done remarkable work bringing it forward. Looking forward to sharing more."

It is the first mainline Wolfenstein game since Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus in 2017. MachineGames paused the series to make Indiana Jones and the Great Circle.

What Microsoft Revealed About Wolfenstein 3

Sharma's post included a photo of what appears to be the first page of the game's script. MachineGames followed with its own post, "His reputation precedes him. Wolfenstein 3 is in production," and shared a photo from its motion capture studio. The two posts confirm a few details:

  • Brian Bloom returns as B.J. Blazkowicz
  • Debra Wilson returns as Grace Walker, the resistance leader from The New Colossus
  • the script page suggests the first chapter is called Nazitraz
  • the opening scene takes place in an interrogation cell

Microsoft has not announced platforms, a release window, or a trailer. MachineGames has developed Wolfenstein for Bethesda since Wolfenstein: The New Order in 2014. Studio head Jerk Gustafsson said last year that the team had "always seen" B.J.'s story as a trilogy. A Wolfenstein TV series is also in development at Amazon.

id Software Is Working on a New Game

Sharma also confirmed that id Software, the studio behind Doom, has started its next project. "Few studios have shaped the first person shooter genre as much as id Software," she wrote, adding that the team "is already working on its next game."

id Software confirmed the project in a reply. The new game comes from its teams in Texas and Frankfurt, with Hugo Martin returning as game director. "It'll be some time before we're ready to share more," the studio said. id Software has not shared a title or genre.

Both studios are part of ZeniMax Media, which Xbox owns. id Software was hit by the Xbox layoffs in July and reportedly lost more than 130 employees. Studio co director Marty Stratton said in October that id is "working more closely with MachineGames than ever."

Doom: The Dark Ages also gets new content. Slaughter Mode, a horde mode with "escalating rounds of random encounters, bosses and arenas," comes to the Revelations expansion on November 16.

Sharma posted a series of announcements on November 12 ahead of the Xbox anniversary on Sunday, November 15. Neither Microsoft nor MachineGames has said when Wolfenstein 3 will be shown.

Thank you for being a Ghacks reader. The post Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially in Production at MachineGames, and id Software Confirms a New Game appeared first on gHacks.
